name: Slick Inatra
backstory: Slick Inatra is a high half elven ranger and sergeant of the Zhentarim who can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three. She is the local leader of the Zhent mercenaries, protecting the Guildhall against Stone Lord intrusions.
